pr_body:
## Problem
The repository already contains a bounded parallel worker function, but the CLI entrypoint never calls it, leaving independent tasks serialized.

## Solution
Connect the existing worker implementation to the `--workers` CLI path while preserving the cap, output count, failures, and external service limits.

## Evidence
DWA-001 contains definition and missing-consumer evidence. A comparable fixture workload improves from 100 to 180 tasks per minute with correctness and resource checks passing.

findings.recommended_action: Connect the existing bounded worker path to --workers dispatch.
findings.summary: Bounded parallel worker capability exists but is not reached from CLI dispatch.

options.description: Reuse parallel_count and connect it to the existing --workers branch without adding a subsystem.
future_actions_accelerated: future CLI parallelism changes use one tested dispatch path
options.recurring_drag_risk: Low; reuses existing implementation and cap.

revision_synthesis.selection_rationale: CLI-OPT-001 has the highest leverage score, reuses verified bounded capability, remains repository-owned, and avoids new maintenance machinery. CLI-OPT-002 is preserved for the external documentation owner.

targets.objective: Route --workers values greater than one through the existing bounded parallel implementation.
targets.title: Activate bounded CLI workers
